Why is profit shared according to

Capital × Time?

Because both the amount invested and the duration of investment contribute to the business.

Can two partners invest equal money but receive different profits?

Yes.

If the investment period is different,

their profit shares will also differ.

Can partners invest different amounts but receive equal profit?

Yes.

If

Capital × Time

becomes equal.

Who is a Working Partner?

A Working Partner

invests money

and actively manages the business.

Who is a Sleeping Partner?

A Sleeping Partner

invests money

but does not participate in daily management.

Can losses also be divided according to the partnership ratio?

Yes.

Unless stated otherwise,

both profit and loss are shared in the same agreed ratio.
